'''The Gulch''' was a vast cavern discovered by [[Korren Starchaser]] inside the [[Serianan Belt]] near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serias]]. It contained mysterious runes that had obviously been carved by [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings.
